mapper.sql: case_id caseId,tenant_id tenantId,store_id storeId,source_owner sourceOwner,source_type sourceType, source_fact_id sourceFactId,dedup_key dedupKey,severity,state,latest_source_event_id latestSourceEventId, latest_source_sequence latestSourceSequence,latest_source_sha256 latestSourceSha256,assignee_user_id assigneeUserId, lease_expires_at leaseExpiresAt,resolver_user_id resolverUserId,reviewer_user_id reviewerUserId, record_version recordVersion,first_observed_at firstObservedAt,last_observed_at lastObservedAt, created_at createdAt,updated_at updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ops_exception_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId}
SELECT FROM ops_exception_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ops_exception_case WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND store_id=#{storeId} AND dedup_key=#{dedupKey}

SELECT observation_id observationId,case_id caseId,source_event_id sourceEventId,source_sequence sourceSequence, source_sha256 sourceSha256,correlation_id correlationId,masked_summary maskedSummary,conflict_flag conflictFlag, observed_at observedAt FROM ops_exception_observation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND owner_code=#{ownerCode} AND source_event_id=#{sourceEventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_exception_case SET latest_source_event_id=#{sourceEventId}, latest_source_sequence=GREATEST(latest_source_sequence,#{sourceSequence}),latest_source_sha256=#{sourceSha256}, severity=#{severity},state=#{targetState},last_observed_at=GREATEST(last_observed_at,#{observedAt}), assignee_user_id=CASE WHEN #{targetState}='REOPENED' THEN NULL ELSE assignee_user_id END, lease_expires_at=CASE WHEN #{targetState}='REOPENED' THEN NULL ELSE lease_expires_at END, resolver_user_id=CASE WHEN #{targetState}='REOPENED' THEN NULL ELSE resolver_user_id END, reviewer_user_id=CASE WHEN #{targetState}='REOPENED' THEN NULL ELSE reviewer_user_id END, record_version=record_version+1,updated_at=#{observedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} AND latest_source_sha256=#{expectedSha256} AND record_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT review_id reviewId,case_id caseId,reviewer_user_id reviewerUserId,decision,reason_sha256 reasonSha256, reviewed_at reviewedAt FROM ops_exception_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} AND decision='APPROVED' ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC,review_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT observation_id observationId,case_id caseId,source_event_id sourceEventId,source_sequence sourceSequence, source_sha256 sourceSha256,correlation_id correlationId,masked_summary maskedSummary,conflict_flag conflictFlag, observed_at observedAt FROM ops_exception_observation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY observed_at,observation_id

SELECT plan_id planId,case_id caseId,action_code actionCode,summary_sha256 summarySha256,planner_user_id plannerUserId, state,created_at createdAt FROM ops_exception_action_plan WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY created_at,plan_id

SELECT repair_command_id repairCommandId,case_id caseId,owner_code ownerCode,action_code actionCode, request_sha256 requestSha256,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,correlation_id correlationId,state, owner_result_reference ownerResultReference,owner_result_sha256 ownerResultSha256,requested_at requestedAt, observed_at observedAt FROM ops_exception_repair_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY requested_at,repair_command_id

SELECT review_id reviewId,case_id caseId,reviewer_user_id reviewerUserId,decision,reason_sha256 reasonSha256, reviewed_at reviewedAt FROM ops_exception_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY reviewed_at,review_id

SELECT state_event_id stateEventId,case_id caseId,from_state fromState,to_state toState,reason_sha256 reasonSha256, actor_user_id actorUserId,occurred_at occurredAt FROM ops_exception_state_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY occurred_at,state_event_id

SELECT audit_id auditId,case_id caseId,action_code actionCode,result_code resultCode,request_sha256 requestSha256, correlation_id correlationId,actor_user_id actorUserId,occurred_at occurredAt FROM ops_exception_audit_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY occurred_at,audit_id
